title: High pressure measurements and molecular modeling of the water content of acid gas containing mixtures
authors: Wael A. Fouad, Matt Yarrison, Kyoo Y. Song, Kenneth R. Cox, Walter G. Chapman
needs_pass2_reason: text layer clean; every cell of Table 3 matched the 200 dpi page image (checked in three zoomed crops)
experimental_method: Dynamic saturation (flow) method: dry gas mixture bubbled through water in a 1300 cm3 saturation cell in an air bath, throttled and analysed by a GE Panametrics moisture analyzer (below 333 K) or desiccant U-tubes weighed on a balance.
uncertainties_stated: Accuracy better than 5 % (mole) of water content in the gas phase; temperature within 0.5 C of set point; pressure within 0.01 % of full scale (high temperature apparatus); gas composition uncertainty 0.05 to 0.01 mol %; air bath controlled within 0.3 K.
quality_remarks: Temperature scale and absolute/gauge pressure not stated. Thermocouple (J-type) calibrated by supplier and checked against NIST-traceable PRT. Some points at lower pressure may lie in the dew-line region of the mixture; not discussed in the table. Gas phase composition is the dry feed gas, not corrected for water.
